_about: Dev-only critical advisories in the SIBLING app's dependency tree (`apps/dsa-web`), disclosed rather than waived. Same contract as `docs/audit/deps-critical.json` for the Interve app: `scripts/audit-deps.mjs` compares this list against `npm --prefix apps/dsa-web audit --json` in both directions, so a new developer-tree critical fails the gate undisclosed, and an entry kept after its package stopped being vulnerable also fails — a register that names a risk the repo no longer carries is a false statement about the product. A critical in the shipped tree (`--omit=dev`) is not registrable at all; that half has no exception path.
_verifiedBy: apps/dsa-web/package.json — `vitest: ^3.2.7` appears under devDependencies and there is no `vitest` key in dependencies
apps/dsa-web/package-lock.json — tinypool resolves to 1.1.1 and is required by vitest (`"tinypool": "^1.1.1"`); no package.json entry names it, so it is transitive
grep over apps/dsa-web/{app,lib,components,mocks} — no source file imports vitest or tinypool; the only importers are test files
npm --prefix apps/dsa-web audit --json on this lockfile — exactly two packages carry a top-level `critical`: vitest and tinypool

devOnlyCritical.why_dev_only: The runner executes tests and is never imported by a module `next build` traces: `vitest` is in devDependencies only, and no file under app/, lib/, components/ or mocks/ imports it. The deployed artefact is the standalone Next build, so the path traversal in `@vitest/mocker`'s redirect mock has no server-side or browser-side caller in this app.
devOnlyCritical.what_actually_fixes_it: vitest >= 4.1.11, which is a major from the pinned ^3.2.7 — the same migration already decided for the Interve app's own runner. There is no patch within 3.x.
devOnlyCritical.decision: OPEN — owner call on the sibling app's major, same shape as the Interve vitest 5 decision

devOnlyCritical.why_dev_only: Transitive under vitest (lockfile resolves tinypool 1.1.1 through the runner, and nothing in package.json names it), so it exists only in the installed developer tree. The prototype-pollution gadget reaches RCE through worker options that only the test runner constructs.
devOnlyCritical.what_actually_fixes_it: tinypool > 2.1.1. It is not a direct dependency, so it moves with the vitest upgrade above rather than being pinned on its own.
devOnlyCritical.decision: OPEN — closes with the vitest major above; no independent action available

closed.note: The `next/og` ImageResponse RCE this app's old pin fell inside. Closed by the upgrade, not by a register entry — listed so the reason the shipped tree is empty of it is readable. scripts/audit-deps.mjs does not read this array.
